blocks.text: Heart Evangelista and John Prats are bringing their love team back to the big screen after more than two decades, as they reunite for a film set for release in February 2027. The actors and former couple announced their upcoming project that will be directed by Prats himself, during a media conference on Friday, Sept. 18.
